Title: New features are now generally available in Event Grid

Body.Content:
The following set of features, previously in preview, are now generally available:

  • Retry policies
  • Dead lettering
  • Storage queues as a destination
  • Hybrid connections as a destination
  • Manual validation handshake

Learn more in the Azure blog
